title: Auditors questioned $1.29 million in food distributed at sites without eligibility forms

beats.text: Auditors checked household eligibility records in a regional federal food program.

visual.sub: Distribution sites and individual records were tested differently

beats.text: In 2022, 14 of 60 sampled participants lacked a documented signature.
In 2023 the audit found seven missing signatures in another sample of 60.
The next year nine of 60 lacked evidence of a signature.
